plan.teaching_goal: Qualify the visual evidence path with two distinct, simple depictions of one dependency-trivial concept. This is a commissioning fixture, not foundational training material.

items.prompt: A clear natural photograph of one ordinary dog standing alone on plain green grass, the entire dog visible, no people, no other animals, no objects, no text, no watermark, neutral daylight.

provenance_requirements: Record the exact FLUX model revision, prompt, seed, dimensions, steps, and image hash.
Keep canonical lesson text separate from generated pixels and observed facts.
Do not admit either candidate without blind inspection and independent pixel review.

experience_events.note: Shadow commissioning stops before experience compilation; accepted asset hashes will be bound in the later admission workflow.
